memory_update.text: AXTI should be promoted to the next research layer as the cleanest US-listed underfollowed direct substrate candidate for InP/GaAs exposure tied to AI optical networking.

COHR and LITE are not pure substrate suppliers but are important demand and chokepoint validators because their InP lasers, photonic devices, transceivers, and AI datacenter optical components sit immediately above the substrate layer.
MTRN remains a speculative shadow candidate until direct exposure to optical transceiver, InP/GaAs, silicon photonics, optical coating, or CPO supply chains is proven from primary disclosures.

Key verification gap: quantify which US-listed companies have merchant InP substrate revenue versus internal InP device/module revenue, and identify whether hyperscaler AI demand is direct, through transceiver customers, or merely inferred from the broader optical cycle.

node: Compound substrates and precision materials for 800G/1.6T optical transceivers and co-packaged optics
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the optical compound-substrate and precision-materials node. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is AXT because its disclosed business is compound semiconductor substrates including InP and GaAs used in optical communications and data-center-related applications. Coherent and Lumentum are included as reference or semi-reference anchors because they are closer to lasers, photonic chips, transceivers, and InP device capacity than to merchant substrate supply, but they help map where substrate demand may surface. Materion is included as a second-order precision-materials and optics hypothesis rather than a confirmed InP substrate beneficiary. No buy, sell, target price, or return view is implied.
